caption: A ceiling fan is switched on under a bright bulb, and the spinning blades throw moving shadows across the room.

sa.check: A ceiling fan is under a bulb.
The spinning blades throw moving shadows across the room.
The fan starts first and the shadows move with it.

pc.expect: The shadows sweep around as fast as the blades and stop when the fan stops.
pc.fail: The shadows are still while the blades turn; or they keep sweeping after the fan stops; or they sweep before the fan starts.

pc.expect: The shadows are blade shapes, one per blade, radiating from the fan's centre.
pc.fail: There are more shadows than blades; or they are unrelated shapes; or they merge into a solid disc while the blades are plainly separate.

pc.expect: The shadows appear on the surfaces below and beside the fan, away from the bulb.
pc.fail: They appear on the ceiling above the bulb; or on the bulb side of the blades; or they are missing with the bulb on.

pc.expect: The shadows move only while the blades turn, and the bulb stays steady.
pc.fail: The shadows sweep with the blades still; or the bulb flickers or moves; or the shadows change with nothing moving.

pc.expect: One fan with its blades and one bulb.
pc.fail: A blade vanishes; or a second fan appears; or a shadow becomes solid; or the fan detaches.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The blades' colour and the room stay the same, and the shadows stay dark.
pc.fail: The blades change colour; or the shadows turn coloured; or the room rearranges.
